result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments or single characters (e.g. 'm' in "Pragmatic", digits in fractions, 'f' in a series formula). Peaks are scattered and the members are generic; there is no clear shared meaning.
result.label: Mid-word fragments, scattered

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ter', 'circul', 'cul' inside anatomical/circulatory words like arteries, circulatory, microcirculatory, and weakly in muscul-, orchestral. Needs the mid-word piece in a biological vessel context.
result.label: ter/circul pieces in arteries, circulatory

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'crete' in "discrete", 'id' in "humidity"/"Dravidian", 'ous' in "continuous", and 'ary'. Peaks are scattered word pieces, and the circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: discrete, humid, continuous

result.description: Fires on analysis-type verbs (analyze, interpret, understand, process, -ing forms) in coordinated lists of verbs, right before an expected object like "data". Silent on 'ing' in other settings.
result.label: Verbs in lists before data object

result.description: Fires on a word-initial fragment such as 'cons' in "reconsider" (also ' abbre' in "abbreviations") in the middle of a word, where the next piece completes the word. Members detect prefix pieces like re-, mis-, ver-, pract-.
result.label: Mid-word 'cons' / 'abbre' fragments

result.description: Fires on the word " tree" (also " named") in computer-science text about data structures like AVL, binary search and decision trees. It was silent on one possessive " tree's" example, but the contrast is thin.
result.label: ' tree' in data-structure text

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments after "sw" (swirling, swimmers, swapped) and on country names in comma lists (Indonesia, Korea). Mixed and low-consistency; mostly word-piece detection with a weak list-of-countries side.
result.label: sw- word fragments, country lists

result.description: Fires on " can" right after a subject noun in a "how X can ..." embedded clause (e.g. "how music can help"). It stays silent on " can" in ordinary main clauses without "how".
result.label: " can" after "how + subject"

result.description: Fires on the plural noun (effects, impacts, implications, applications) after an adjective like "direct", "cascading" or "broad" in a "have X effects/impacts on" phrase. It stays silent on the same tokens in other constructions, such as "Evaluating the impacts of".
result.label: Plural effects/impacts after adjective

result.description: Fires on 'and' / 'as' (in 'as well as') linking two paired academic or domain adjectives/nouns (academic and practical, theoretical and practical), after the first element of a "both X and Y" style pairing. Predicts a contrasting word like 'practical'.
result.label: Coordinator between paired academic terms

result.description: Fires on the last token of a topic-noun title phrase, such as "therapy" in "music therapy" or "reality" in "virtual reality". These are often headings where a subject term is complete and a verb like "is" or "has" could come next. Mixed evidence.
result.label: End of compound topic term

result.description: Fires on ' it' (occasionally ' them') when it is the object of a verb or preposition (e.g. "of it", "preparing it", "breaking them"). It stays silent on ' it' as a sentence subject, especially before contractions like "it's" or "it'll".
result.label: Object pronoun ' it'/' them'

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in technical or enumerating text (units like Hz, "degrees", "angles", "condition", a letter in a class list). No single token or context dominates, and the circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Scattered technical-term tokens, diffuse

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' ident' / ' Ident' (before -ities, -ifying, -ification), also weakly on similar prefix fragments like 'origin', 'A'. Predicts suffix continuations such as 'ifying' or 'ities'.
result.label: ' ident' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on scattered separators and function words (commas, semicolons, 'and', 'the') inside lists of abstract nouns like "entities, attributes, and relationships". Predicts abstract noun suffixes (-ity, -ation). Weak, mixed evidence.
result.label: List separators before abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on a comma ending a clause that closes with "this trend/shift/regard/aspect" or a similar abstract noun, where a relative or participial clause ("which...", "resulting in...") follows. Silent on many other commas after clauses.
result.label: Comma after "this trend" clauses
'ence' completing 'essence'
result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ence' when it completes the word "essence", especially in the phrase "in essence". It stays silent on 'ence' in other words such as resilience, ambivalence or adherence.

Fires on the token " discuss" (discusses, discussing, discussions), especially when a section or part of a text describes what it covers. Members are mostly detectors of "discuss" and similar word stems like teach, convers and contract.
result.label: ' discuss' word stem detector

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ate' in "corporate" (weakly 'ational' in "organizational"), mostly before words like governance, accountability or social responsibility. Silent on 'ate' in other words such as Directorate, cultivate, anticipate, participate.
result.label: 'ate' ending of "corporate"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' catal' (start of catalyst/catalysis/catalyzing), and weakly on 're' in "disagreements" and similar mid-word pieces. Members are mostly ' catal' detectors from layers 3-5.
result.label: ' catal' word piece (catalyst)

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ur' in "impurities" and "heuristic", plus ' clear', ' transparent' and 'ark' in "quark". Silent on 'ur' in "culturally". Mixed word pieces with weak consistency.
result.label: 'ur' in impurities/heuristic, clear

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'as' in "Plasmonics/plasmon" (also 'ast', 'ur' in plastics, plurality). It acts as a word-piece inside "pl-" words, and is silent on 'as' in other words like "speakeasies".
result.label: 'as' inside Plasmon words

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: the Greek letter λ in math (eigenvalue, rate parameter), suffix pieces like 'ive' and 'zes', and ' roof'. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse, so no single trigger is clear.
result.label: Mixed tokens, math λ and suffixes

result.description: Fires on ' framework' (also ' approach', ' method', '-ology') when it begins a sentence as the subject, right after a period, referring back to a previously mentioned system. It stays silent on 'a framework for' mid-sentence.
result.label: Sentence-initial 'framework' as subject

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of a rare word split into several tokens, especially 'est' in "Aesthetic" at the start of a title or heading, also 'f', 'olate', 'ph'. Silent on 'est' in "orchestral".
result.label: Mid-word fragments in split rare words

result.description: Fires mostly on ' early' (e.g. "late 1950s and early", repeated "early") and on scattered mid-word or adjective pieces in science text (continental, oceanic, floor). Silent on "the early 20…" century contexts. Evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: ' early' in non-century contexts

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'text' (in subtext, \text{ in LaTeX, ciphertext) and 'iz' in Al-Khwarizmi, where a word continues with a suffix. Peaks are a mix of unrelated word fragments; the evidence is thin and mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'text' and 'iz'

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: 'x' inside derivative notation f'(x), mid-word pieces (Col-in, semi-ann-ual), commas and some function words. No single token or context dominates; the evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: Scattered mid-word and 'x' pieces

result.description: Fires on method-like nouns (' method', ' approach', ' framework') right after an evaluative adjective such as "systematic", "methodical", "efficient" or "traditional", when the text describes something offering a way of doing a task. Silent on bare or "this method" uses.
result.label: method/approach noun after adjective

result.description: Fires on commas separating items in a list of parallel items (e.g. "architecture, engineering, technology" or "x₁, x₂"), where more items are expected. It stays silent on commas that end a clause.
result.label: Comma inside list of items

result.description: Fires on "ent" in "inherent" (also "afforded", "required", "placed") when it follows an abstract noun phrase and precedes "in"/"by", as in "fairness inherent in" or "precision afforded by". It stays silent on "inherent" followed directly by a noun.
result.label: inherent/afforded before in/by

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ade' in "inadequate", where the model is mid-word and expects "quate" next. Weak activation on other mid-word fragments like 'arma' in pharmaceutical.
result.label: 'ade' in "inadequate"

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, mostly ' pair' and the verb ' is' (also "There's", ' and'), where a verb or noun phrase continues. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low. The logits are not clear.
result.label: Mixed ' pair' and ' is' tokens

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of technical or science words that are split into pieces, mainly ' cou' (coulometry, coulomb, coupling), also ' Vol' (Volta), ' Circ', ' Tele'. It fires mid-word, expecting a continuation piece.
result.label: Split-word fragment 'cou' in science terms

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in longer words, mostly 'iz' (Organizational, wizards, Citizenship) and 'c' in 'transcends'. It also fires weakly on a few prefix pieces such as ' compreh' and ' ab'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'iz', 'trans-c'

result.description: Fires on ' health'/' Health' as the start of a healthcare topic or heading (Healthcare economics, Health Insurance), especially at document or heading starts. Silent on 'health' after modifiers like 'public' or 'systemic'. Predicts 'care'.
result.label: health at healthcare topic start

result.description: Fires on varied mid-word pieces and word endings (yt, rop, ation, building, access) in technical or scientific text, often where a word may continue or a suffix completes it. Peaks are scattered and the evidence is weak.
result.label: Scattered word-piece fragments in technical text

result.description: Fires on a comma (occasionally ' and') right after "evolve"/"evolving"-type verbs of change, where a list of further change verbs follows (evolve, adapt, ...). Silent on commas in other clauses.
result.label: Comma after evolve-type verb

result.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a word split into several tokens (Mil|ky, s|tere|otype, J|PE|G, hero|ism), where a suffix is expected next. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low, so the pattern is loose.
result.label: Incomplete word fragment mid-word

result.description: Fires on the "end" piece in "exp-end-iture" (expenditure, in public finance text), predicting the continuation "iture". Weak activity on a few other odd tokens.
result.label: "end" inside expenditure

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, often science nouns or word pieces (ants, wine, fung, products, '-' in predator-prey, digit '1'), mostly in science text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse. Logits favor adjectives like specific, exclusive, unique.
result.label: Diffuse science-noun mix

result.description: Fires mostly on ' and' in coordinated lists of nouns or adjectives, plus word pieces like ' rec', 'ive', ' aud' that begin or continue an expected next item. It stays silent on many other ' and' cases, and the condition is unclear.
result.label: Coordinating 'and' in lists

result.description: Fires on connectors (' from', ',', ' with', ' of') right after a process noun like testing, feedback, or collaboration in iterative-cycle or process-description text. It stays silent on 'from' in other uses, such as 'range from' or 'different from'.
result.label: Connector after process noun

result.description: Fires on "uring" in "enduring" (as in "create enduring long-term..."), the adjective meaning lasting. It stays silent on "uring" in other words such as manufacturing, measuring and ensuring. Members detect lasting/endure word pieces.
result.label: "enduring" word piece 'uring'

result.description: Fires mainly on 'omed' in a repeated "Biomedical" course-list heading (second occurrence, "Bi-omed-ical"), and on ' designed' in "designed to". Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: 'omed' in Biomedical, ' designed'

result.description: Fires on ' including' (also 'such as', 'like') right after a phrase like "in various fields/sectors", where a list of example domains or industries is about to start. Silent when 'including' follows a non-domain list.
result.label: Examples list after "various fields"

result.description: Fires on word endings or nouns in descriptions of a culture's or era's art and creative expression (art-istic, art-istry, creative expressions, flavors, spirit). It stays silent on some 'artistic expression' cases and on 'linguistic', so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Cultural artistic expression word endings

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ci' inside the word "speciation" and its variants (speciatory, speciogenetic) in evolutionary biology text. It is silent when 'ci' starts a fresh word after a period.
result.label: 'ci' inside "speciation"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that are the start of a longer word split into pieces, mainly ' ton' (before -ality), ' Fund' (amental), ' fil', ' Est'. Often in music or abstract academic text. Predicts a word continuation.
result.label: Word-start fragments like ton-/Fund-

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'ipp' inside "stippling" (also in "ripples"), where a suffix continuation is expected. Weak, scattered activity on ' definition' and a few other words. Members are mostly 'ipp' piece detectors.
result.label: 'ipp' in stippling

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens (' only', ' Rich', ' section', ' theory', ' also'), mostly ' only' in non-"not only" use. Silent on ' only' after "not" or "can". Members are mostly junk-token detectors, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: Mixed ' only' / ' Rich' tokens
Diffuse mid-word and ' between' firing
result.description: Fires weakly on scattered tokens: ' between', word pieces (avel, itive, T in won't), 's in let's. No dominant token or clear context; members are diffuse with low specificity. Predicts verb-like next tokens weakly. Low faithfulness.

Fires on the end of positive quality adjectives in lists of system or material traits, such as resil-ient, reliable, secure, sturdy and dependable. It stays silent on 'ient' in 'proficient', so it needs this descriptive-adjective sense.
result.label: Resilient/reliable/secure quality adjectives

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "rent" inside "apprentice/apprenticeship", and also on " patron" and "emph" (emphasis). These are mid-word pieces where the word is not yet complete; the logits suggest no clear next token.
result.label: "rent" in apprentice; patron, emph

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, such as ' pl' (planners, plastic), 'current' (currently, concurrent) and '-' in Sturm-Liouville, where the next piece must complete the word. Silent on ' pl' after 'provides'. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (pl, current)

result.description: Fires on plural category nouns (projects, aspects, areas, matters, issues, fields) right after a quantifier like "various" or "range of", where a list of types follows. Silent on "their projects" with a possessive.
result.label: Plural noun after "various"

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-piece 'rec' at the start of a longer word like "precision" or "recognition", where a suffix such as -ision comes next. Weaker, scattered hits on other word fragments and on '1' in digit strings.
result.label: 'rec' word-start fragment (precision)

result.description: Fires on the word-start token ' abandon' (mostly before '-ment') and on ' confront' (before '-ation'), with a few other word pieces like 'rac' in 'embraced'. It marks an incomplete word stem awaiting a suffix.
result.label: abandon-/confront- word stems

result.description: Fires on the quantifier ' some' (also 'Some') introducing a noun phrase, e.g. "there may be some", "examine some of". Members are mostly ' some' detectors; no clear extra condition from the contrast.
result.label: ' some' quantifier detector

result.description: Fires on the modal ' must' after a noun subject (e.g. "ideas must be developed"), and more weakly on obligation 'to' ("required to", "forced to"). Members are mostly ' must' detectors in formal, expository text.
result.label: Obligation modal ' must'
'oph' in "homophone" word pieces
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'oph' inside "hom-oph-one(s)" and similar technical words (geophysics, esophagus, Diophantine). Stays silent on 'oph' in "sophisticated". Weaker on 'oul' in Bernoulli.

result.label: 'u' inside "fluctuations"
result.description: Fires mainly on the 'u' piece in "fluct-u-ations/fluctuating", where a word-piece detector cluster predicts the continuation. It also fires weakly on ' to' after "turning/turned".

Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ote' in Geotechnical/geo- words, and ' Cons' in 'Sequential Consistency', where a word is being built and 'chn'/'istency' continuations are expected. Silent on 'ote' in 'otechnology' without a geo/nano prefix.
result.label: Mid-word 'ote' after geo-/nano-

result.description: Fires on variation/specifier adjectives like "different", "varying", "various", "certain", "distinct", "specific" placed before a plural noun. Predicts nouns like kinds, amounts, types. Silent on the contrast text, which lacks such a word.
result.label: Variety adjectives before plural nouns

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start fragments (' uniqu', ' vari', ' oblig', ' manif', ' li') in abstract academic text, where the next piece is a suffix completing the word (-ely, -ability, -ation). Predicts suffix continuation.
result.label: Word-start fragments awaiting suffix

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: quantity nouns like " number", " amount", " extent" before "of" (e.g. "the number of"), plus "it" inside words like "epitaxial" or "parasitic". Silent on "A significant number of". Mixed, weak evidence.
result.label: Quantity nouns 'the number of' and 'it' pieces

result.description: Fires on plural abstract nouns (methods, forms, applications, capabilities, explanations) after a comparative "more/wider/higher + adjective" phrase, where "than" is likely next. Silent on "methods" after technical field words like computational or statistical.
result.label: Noun after comparative modifier, expecting 'than'

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside longer, multi-piece words (Ger-b-ner, Liter-ary, cru-cial, et-iquette), where the word is incomplete and a suffix is expected. Peaks are varied; the evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of split words

result.description: Fires mostly on " font"/" Font" (also " type", " ser" of serif) in typography text, especially after style words like serif or classic. Silent in one font example. Predicts word-continuation suffixes like "-", "ive", "ion". Circuit is diffuse and weak.
result.label: font word in typography text

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of longer words, mainly 'elect' in piezoelectric, ' comple' (complements), 'over', and the ' <' of HTML tags. Peaks are mixed, and the logits show no clear next-token pattern.
result.label: Word-start fragments: elect, comple, over

result.description: Fires on the possessive ' their' (also his, its, 's) right after a clause opener like "how", "where", "the way", "that", when a possessed noun with its own possessive follows. Silent after "as", "within", "discuss".
result.label: Possessive 'their' after clause openers

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' ob' (objection, oboe, obedience) and ' pun' (punctuation, puns), weaker on ' dep' (depicting), where the word continues in the next token. Members are mostly ' ob'/' pun' token detectors.
result.label: Word-start fragments ob / pun

result.description: Fires on the 'st' token in "Amidst" at the start of a document (e.g. "Amidst a global..."). Silent on 'st' in ordinal "21st". Weak on a few other word-piece splits.
result.label: "st" in "Amidst"

result.description: Fires on ' the' after a verb or preposition (affect, regardless of, independently of, state of) in quantum-physics text about particle states, predicting "state"/"states" next. Silent on ' the' in other constructions, like after "contravening" or "comprised of".
result.label: ' the' before "state" in quantum text

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' atmos' (before -pheric) and ' determin' (before -ant/-ism), where the token is an incomplete prefix of a longer word. Members are detectors of these pieces and 'air'/'mos'.
result.label: atmos- and determin- word prefixes

result.description: Fires on the word piece "it" inside multi-piece words, such as aud-it, expend-it-ures and exc-it-onic. It stays quiet on "it" in other words like legitimate, prioritizing, deficit and facilitates.
result.label: "it" piece in aud-it, expend-it-ures

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of long multi-piece words, mainly 'dep' in interdependence, 'av' in concavity, also ' contrib' and 'defin' in indefinite. Fires on the word piece before the rest of the word completes.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: dep, av, contrib

result.description: Fires on a sentence-ending period in text that compares two related topics or approaches, where the next sentence likely begins with a reference like "The former/latter" or "These". It is silent on many periods in similar text, and the cause isn't clear.
result.label: Period in two-topic comparison text

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: ' the' after verbs like convey/communicate, the 'urt' piece in nurture/kurtosis, and word-initial 'd'. The mix is inconsistent, and ' the' is often silent elsewhere, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed: 'the', 'urt', 'd' pieces

result.description: Fires on the end of a word or compound after a specific prefix: ' programming' after "dynamic", 'here' in "adhere", 'ning' in "spinning". Mixed word-final pieces; the tokens share no meaning, and the next token is often a continuation like "to" or "strictly".
result.label: Word-final pieces: programming, adhere, spinning

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'ete' in "Intrusion Detection" (a misspelled/split "Dete-ction"), and weakly on other mid-word pieces like 'ks' in "seeks". Members are detectors of 'ete' pieces.
result.label: 'ete' piece in Detection

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " simulation" (also at the start of " Liter" in "Literary") in technical or scientific text. Members are mostly detectors of "simulation" and related words such as MD, simulations and models. The contrast text is silent where the word is absent.
result.label: ' simulation' token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on " inner" (as in "inner membrane" or "inner function"), with scattered weaker hits on "1", "Real", and word pieces. Members detect "inner"/"internal". The circuit is a poor fit, and the peaks are mixed.
result.label: " inner" token with scattered pieces

result.description: Fires on the piece 'are' inside the name "Pareto" (P-are-to), after the 'P'. It stays silent on 'are' in "welfare" or when 'are' starts a word. Members include detectors for 'are' after P and similar name fragments.
result.label: 'are' inside Pareto

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of longer split words, mainly 'alg' in "amalgamation" and 'mit' in "mitochondrial"/"mitigation", also 'Alg' in "Algorithms". It sits at an incomplete word piece where a continuation is expected.
result.label: Split-word fragments alg/mit

result.description: Fires mostly on " defect" in materials-science text (point defect, line defect, lattice defect), with weaker activity on function words like "the" and "of" in technical math or science instructions. Members are mainly defect/fault detectors.
result.label: defect in technical science text

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens in historical or origin-themed text, mainly ' back' in "traced back", plus ' Middle' (Ages), ' Iron' (Age) and word pieces. It is silent on "falling back" (non-historical). Members detect ancient-history and origin words.
result.label: Historical origin "traced back" words

result.description: Fires on the token " active" / " Active", mostly in the grammar sense (active vs passive voice) or in terms like active listening and active systems. Silent on some " active" contexts, e.g. at the start of "active voice" or after "an".
result.label: ' active' token detector

result.description: Fires on plural or suffix word endings (-ets, -s, -ements, -ics) completing a topic heading in outline-style lists of short titles, e.g. "Labor Markets", "Pronouns". Silent on the same suffix in running prose or other headings.
result.label: Plural endings in outline headings

result.description: Fires on " needed" in inline wiki-style editorial tags like "[citation needed]", "[clarification needed]", "[note needed]". It also weakly fires on similar words such as "necessary" or "required" after a noun.
result.label: " needed" in citation-needed tags

result.description: Fires on a word-initial fragment (mostly ' d', also 'p' in 'fast-paced', 'rac', ' condu') that starts a longer word split across tokens, such as 'ethical d|ilemma'. Mostly in academic or abstract text; the next piece is predicted to complete the word.
result.label: Word-start fragment ' d' before continuation

result.description: Fires on 'and' (or comma) right after the noun "health" in a list of concerns, e.g. "human health and the environment". Silent on 'and' in other lists such as pollutants or practices.
result.label: 'and' after "health" in lists

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces (' plot', ' character', ' lab', ' met', ' inn') in essays about fiction, storytelling and narrative craft, often at word starts. Members are mostly narrative/reader/character topic detectors, so the peaks are mixed.
result.label: Narrative-craft essay word pieces

result.description: Fires on focusing adverbs such as "particularly", "specifically", "especially" and "particular(ly)", mostly after a comma or semicolon introducing a narrowing qualification in academic text. Silent when "particularly" is a plain intensifier in "being particularly crucial".
result.label: Focusing adverbs: particularly, specifically

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces completing durability/lifetime-type nouns: "lifes-pan", "longe-vity", also "tre-asure". Appears in engineering/product-durability text about extending lifespan or longevity of components.
result.label: lifespan/longevity word endings

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, 'and', 'vs', 'versus', word pieces) inside lists or contrasts of items, such as "such as crisp versus creamy" or "creamy, crunchy". Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: List and contrast separators

result.description: Fires on the word piece " discover" when it is a stem expecting a suffix like -ing, -ies, -ed (e.g. "like discovering"). Silent when " discover" begins "discoveries". Members detect discover/cover/discovery word-family pieces.
result.label: ' discover' stem before suffix

result.description: Fires on ' not' in "whether or not", and on "neither/either" in correlative pairs (neither...nor, either...or). Silent on ' not' in "not just", "or not" at clause end, or "but not".
result.label: Correlative 'whether or not' / neither

result.description: Fires on verbs of causing or igniting, mainly ' spark' (sparked ideological...), also ' fuel', 'spurred', ' entertain', ' prompt', when a subject sets off a development. Members detect spark/trigger/ignite words and their suffixes.
result.label: spark / fuel / spur causation verbs

result.description: Fires on the digits '0' or '1' inside ISO standard numbers (ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 9001, 25010), i.e. the later digits of the code. It stays silent on '0' in years and decades such as 1970s or 20th.
result.label: Digits inside ISO standard numbers

result.description: Fires on the "ence" ending of "essence" (also "essentially") in the sentence-opening phrase "In essence," meaning "basically". It stays silent on "essence" as a noun, as in "the essence of culinary...", and on "opulence".
result.label: "In essence" summarizing phrase

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces in heading-like multiword terms, mainly 'ain' in "Supply Chain" at the start of a document, and ' isol' in "isolation". Weaker on other word fragments. Peaks are scattered and fairly inconsistent.
result.label: Word fragments in title headings

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in long, multi-piece words (uncon-vent-ional, double-bl-ind, Ass-ess-ment), where the word is incomplete and a suffix is expected. Logits are weak; the peaks are diverse word pieces.
result.label: Mid-word fragments in long words

result.description: Fires on ' the' and nouns like ' notes' or ' identity' after verbs like "enhances" or "adds to" in text about music, rhythm and melody. It is silent on ' the' after prepositions such as "to" or "from". Members are mostly music-word detectors.
result.label: Object noun slot in music text

result.description: Fires on ' approach' (also 'ach', '-ology', ' perspective') when it follows a modifier naming a method or school, like "constructivist approach" or "Agile approach". It stays silent when 'approach' starts a sentence or follows a generic adjective like 'strategic' or 'holistic'.
result.label: Named-method 'approach' after modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece "per" at the start of a word, mostly in "high-performance" (also periph-, permeable, angiosperm), predicting continuations like "formance". Weaker on " Energy" in headings.
result.label: "per" word piece, high-performance

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside "Mesopotamia" and "Sumerians" ('am' in Mesopot-am-ia, 'umer' in S-umer-ians), in ancient Mesopotamia history text. Silent on garbled or misspelled variants of the word.
result.label: Mesopotamia/Sumerian word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' impl' (as in "implants") when it begins a longer word, mostly in biomedical or engineering text. Members are detectors of other word-initial fragments (restaur, er, struct), which suggests it responds to an incomplete word-start.
result.label: ' impl' word-start fragment (implants)

result.description: Fires on articles (' a', ' the', ' an', ' their') directly after a form of "play/played/playing", as in "play a role" or "playing the cards". Silent on ' a' in other constructions like "just a" or "has a".
result.label: Article after "play"

result.description: Fires on the "aging" piece of "managing" (also weakly on " manage"), when it follows "man". Stays silent on "aging" in "leveraging" and "disengaging". It predicts objects such as resources or risk.
result.label: "aging" in "managing"

result.description: Fires on 'j' inside "disjunction/conjunction"-type words and on ' World' in "World War"/"World of", i.e. word pieces where a specific continuation follows. Mixed, low-faithfulness circuit with two main token families.
result.label: 'j' in disjunct- and ' World' (War)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' prefer' (as in "preferences") when it starts a word, plus ' termin' and ' Professor' at the start of a name line in a list of academics. Silent in one "user preferences" context, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: ' prefer' word-piece (preferences)

result.description: Fires on the token ' situ' in the Latin phrases "in situ" and "ex situ" (conservation, soil methods). Members are mostly ' situ' detectors plus word-piece detectors for incomplete words such as gravit-, organiz-, divers-.
result.label: ' situ' in in situ / ex situ
' isol' word-piece in isolation
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' isol' at the start of "isolation" or "isolate", mostly in biogeography and science text. It also fires weakly on a few other word-start fragments such as 'emp' and 'pre'.

Fires on the final token of historical event names, mostly "formation" in "Reformation" and " Revolution", in history outlines about Protestant Reformation-era topics. Silent on art-criticism headings.
result.label: Reformation / Revolution historical event ends

result.description: Fires on the word piece " entrepr" (start of entrepreneur/entrepreneurship/entrepreneurial) when the rest of the word is still to come. It predicts continuation pieces like "ene". Weak firing on a few other split word starts.
result.label: ' entrepr' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on consequence adverbs like "thus", "effectively", "thereby" that open a participle clause after a comma, describing a result of the preceding clause. Predicts a verb like "resulting", "leading", "creating".
result.label: Consequence adverb before participle

result.description: Fires mostly on commas (also 'more', 'eg') inside lists of abstract fields or topics, such as "philosophy, mathematics, astronomy" or "navigation, architecture, engineering". It stays silent on commas after "properties" that introduce a clause. The circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Commas in topic/field lists

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'ene' inside longer words (bottlenecks, entrepreneurs, ethene, Hermeneutic), also 'alls' in firewalls. It is silent on 'ene' in the name René, so it needs the word-internal context.
result.label: Mid-word 'ene' piece (bottlenecks)

result.description: Fires on the word " credit" in finance and banking text, especially before "risk", "rating" or "assessment" (e.g. "robust credit risk management"). It stays silent on interest-rate text without the word credit.
result.label: ' credit' in banking text

result.description: Fires on commas separating items in a list of abstract nouns (techniques, methods, materials, practices), mid-list where more items follow. Silent on commas ending a list or clause, e.g. before "which" or "emphasizing".
result.label: Comma inside noun lists

result.description: Fires on 'ar' (also 'ur', 'yc', 'itar') as a mid-word fragment inside rare names and transliterated titles, such as Jawaharlal, Kiparsky, Mukhtasar. Silent on 'ar' in Nagarjuna, so it needs particular word contexts.
result.label: 'ar' fragment inside rare names

result.description: Fires on abstract plural nouns (practices, values, beliefs, interests, methods, skills) that are items in a comma-separated list of abstract concepts, usually in cultural or educational text. Silent when 'practices' follows a modifier or 'and'.
result.label: Plural abstract noun in list

result.description: Fires mainly on " tell"/" tells" (verb of telling a story) and on "Per" in "Future Perfect"/"Present Perfect" grammar headings. Members detect tell/telling and similar verbs (perform, play, sing). Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: tell/tells and "Per" in Perfect

result.description: Fires on the piece 'm' in the middle of a longer word where more letters follow, such as Prag|m|atic, Dile|m|ma, Car|m|ichael, enig|m|atic. It stays quiet on 'm' ending words like realm and palm.
result.label: Mid-word 'm' piece (Pragmatic, Dilemma)

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-start piece ' ling' (as in "lingua franca"), and weakly on ' a' or ' mental'. Members detect incomplete word fragments (ling, rib, Ide, pie, ple) where a longer word continues.
result.label: ling- word-fragment (lingua franca)

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'alla' in "fallacies", also 'ur' in "heuristics" and 'Econom'. It needs the piece inside a longer word that is still being spelled out; the standalone 'alla' in "allachievements" stays silent.
result.label: 'alla' in fallacies word-piece

result.description: Fires on the noun ' point' or ' moment(s)' right after an adjective like turning, pivotal or defining, meaning a significant historical juncture. Silent on other uses of 'point', such as 'at the point' or 'comparison point'.
result.label: Turning point / pivotal moment

result.description: Fires mainly on the mid-word piece 'u' in "Altruism" (also 'in' pieces like webinars, ponin). Silent on 'u' in "linguistic". Members are mostly 'u' and 'in' token detectors. Weak, mixed circuit.
result.label: 'u' in Altruism word piece

result.description: Fires on the verb ending of "exposes", "reveals" and similar (poses, als, shows) when a subject like a study or examination is the agent and an object that is revealed comes next. Weaker on "showing" and "see".
result.label: Reveals/exposes verb endings

result.description: Fires on the word " entropy" (and pieces like "vern", "ropy") in physics and information-theory text. Members are mostly entropy detectors plus related physics terms such as velocity, momentum and eigenvalues. Silent in a thermodynamics sentence that lacks the word.
result.label: entropy word detector

result.description: Fires on the comparative suffix "er" in "cooler" (also "der", "mer") in climate/temperature text, where a "than" or comparison may follow. It stays silent on "er" in other words such as "riser" or "nearer", and weakly on "darker".
result.label: Comparative "cooler" suffix in climate text

result.description: Fires on the 'break' piece in 'outbreak' (e.g. disease outbreaks), after 'out'. Silent on related health text without the word. Upstream members detect 'break' after 'out' and disease context.
result.label: 'break' in 'outbreak'

result.description: Fires on the 'ut' piece in "pharmaceutical" (and biopharmaceutical), with weaker firing on ' phr' in "noun phrases". Silent on 'ut' in "pollutant" and "therapeutic".
result.label: 'ut' in pharmaceutical

result.description: Fires on creation/enrichment verbs (' create', 'enrich', 'enhance') right after "can" with a professional subject like teachers, educators or chefs, in education/practice-advice text. It stays quiet on 'create' after "to" or in other constructions.
result.label: "can create" after educators/professionals

result.description: Fires on contrastive conjunctions, mainly ' while' and ' whereas', often after a semicolon or at the start of a sentence, introducing a contrasting clause. It stays silent on some ' while' cases, such as after commas or where 'while' means 'during'.
result.label: Contrastive 'while' / 'whereas' conjunction

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, often word-start or mid-word pieces (product, port, u, its, etic) where a word is being continued or completed. Peaks are inconsistent, and the same token ' its' is silent in other contexts. Evidence is thin.
result.label: Scattered word-piece continuation, unclear

result.description: Fires on the caret '^' in LaTeX exponents and on long runs of dashes (markdown horizontal rules after a paragraph). Members detect LaTeX backslash/comma symbols and math notation. Mixed, low-faithfulness circuit.
result.label: Caret and dash-rule symbols

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments (reg, g, co, ant, rot, hyphen) in scientific, mostly molecular biology text, where a longer technical word is being continued. Predicts biology-style word continuations like -ibberellin or -operative. Silent on one 'reg' in 'regulation' contrast.
result.label: Biology word-fragment prefixes

result.description: Fires on commas, "and", "or" and "/" that join items in a list of abstract nouns (ideas, concepts, and entities; words, phrases, sentences, and texts). It is silent on commas in other roles, such as after introductory phrases.
result.label: List separators between abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces of technical or academic terms like ' Nav' (Navier-Stokes), ' Orth' (Orthographic), 'ier', 'rod'. Mostly early fragments of a multi-piece word where a technical continuation is expected, in math/physics/linguistics text.
result.label: Technical term opening fragments (Nav, Orth)

result.description: Fires on function or linking words (and, their, supports, food) in environmental and conservation text about species, habitats and ecosystems. It predicts a next noun like habitat, fish, species or conservation.
result.label: Ecology text, predicts habitat/species noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece " concentr" (start of concentration/concentrated), mostly in science text about substances or gases, predicting the suffix "ations". Weak on a few other nouns like resolution or capacity.
result.label: ' concentr' word piece before -ations

result.description: Fires on words following stretching/holding instructions (repeatedly, upwards, and, -ed, tightly) in how-to text about stretching dough, hands or material; predicts body parts like legs, feet, fingers. Silent on ' in' in other contexts.
result.label: Stretching-instruction continuation words

result.description: Fires on 's, a following quote, 'and', or suffix pieces right after a philosopher's name (Plato's, Platon'S "The Republic", Chomskyian) in philosophy text. It stays silent on 's in "it's" or after Aristotle in other contexts.
result.label: Possessive after philosopher names

result.description: Fires right after "word"/term in etymology statements ("comes from the Greek word for", "word 'x'", "means"), where a gloss or quoted translation comes next. Silent on ordinary "for" uses.
result.label: Etymology gloss slot after "word"

result.description: Fires on the token " compression" in data/image/audio compression text (lossless, lossy, wavelet compression). Upstream members are mostly compression detectors plus signal-processing words like filtering, noise and formats.
result.label: ' compression' in signal processing

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'ist' in "pr-ist-ine" (and similar word fragments like 'tt', 'cut'), where the word is still incomplete. It stays silent on 'ist' as a suffix meaning a person or movement (Cubist, Expressionist).
result.label: 'ist' inside 'pristine'

result.description: Fires on a hyphen or en dash joining a compound modifier, mostly after adjectives like "large", "small", "larger" where a scale/type/class word is expected. Silent on hyphens after "one", "self", "problem", "cost".
result.label: Hyphen in size-adjective compounds

result.description: Fires on plural suffix pieces (-ys, -ges, -els, -ches, -es) ending split nouns in lists of landforms, terrain and structures (tunnels, ridges, lanes, cliffs, islets). Needs a geography or landscape listing context; silent on 'analyses'.
result.label: Plural endings in landform lists

result.description: Fires on a noun (cell, energy, repair, storage, transport) right after "essential for / regulating / support" in nutrition and biology text about lipids and vitamins. It predicts health-related nouns like membranes. Silent on "cell" in "cellular" or technical cell-biology text.
result.label: Biological function noun after "essential for"

result.description: Fires on ' fields' (or ' field') right after "magnetic" or "electric" in physics text about electromagnetism. Silent on ' fields' meaning areas of study, as in "various fields" or "other fields".
result.label: Physical field after magnetic/electric

result.description: Fires on mid-word uppercase fragments (SE, CH, GE, AD, ES, AST) inside words written in all-caps text, such as ITSELF, PROMISE, ROASTER'S. Weakly on acronyms like FMEA and SAS. Predicts further capital letters continuing the word.
result.label: All-caps mid-word fragments

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'iv' and 'uls' inside words like pulsar, pulses, pivotal, herbivores, after an initial 'p' or similar prefix. Predicts continuations like 'otal'. Also weakly on odd bytes.
result.label: 'iv'/'uls' word-piece in pulsar/pivotal

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' harm' / 'Harm' when it begins "harmony/harmonic" and the next piece is expected to be 'ony' or 'onic'. Silent when ' harm' appears at the very start of the text, as in "harmonic vocab…". Members are detectors of the same token.
result.label: harm- start of harmony/harmonic

result.description: Fires on policy-type nouns (Policy, policy, laws, statements) right after "Environmental" or similar environment/governance modifiers. Silent on "Environmental Engineering" in a list of fields, so it needs the policy/regulation noun in an environmental context.
result.label: Environmental policy noun

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces inside long technical words, mostly biology/immunology terms like re-ceptor, TC(R), phosphol-ip-ase, hormones, though also 'sk' in skill. Predicts word-completion pieces. Mixed, moderate evidence.
result.label: Mid-word pieces in biology terms

result.description: Fires on the preposition ' for' (sometimes ' to') right after verbs of preparing or adapting, such as "prepare for", "prepared for", "adapting to". It stays silent on other uses of ' for', such as "for years" or "for instance".
result.label: preposition after prepare/adapt

result.description: Fires on the word "commas" (comm|as, ' comma') when it appears in lists of punctuation marks or grammar and writing-style rules, such as "symbols such as commas, periods". Silent on lists of rhetorical devices.
result.label: comma in punctuation lists

result.description: Fires on "acid" / "acids" (often the "ids" piece of "acids") in chemistry text, especially after names like carboxylic, hydrochloric or citric. Silent on unrelated text, so it seems to need a chemistry context.
result.label: acid(s) in chemistry text

result.description: Fires mostly on 'ega' in "omega" (e.g. omega-3), plus mid-word pieces like 'u' in "fluctuations", hyphens after prefixes such as anti-, and ' Dark' in "Dark Matter". It looks like a word-piece completion detector, and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: 'ega' in omega, mid-word pieces

result.description: Fires on the noun ending a phrase like "the latest frontier", "a new area/era/field" (frontier, area, era, field), where something is described as a new or emerging domain, usually followed by "of" or "in".
result.label: New frontier/area/era noun

result.description: Fires on the period ending a short topic-title line in a list of headings or topics (e.g. "Education and the arts.", "Flutes."), before a newline and the next item. It is silent on some similar title periods, and the contrast doesn't show why.
result.label: Period after list-item topic titles

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ility' (also 'ibility') completing "versatility", strongest there; weaker on agility and flexibility. Silent on 'ility' in "desirability", so it needs the word versatility/flexibility-like stem.
result.label: 'versatility' suffix 'ility'

result.description: Fires on the article ' a'/' an' right after "possess" (leaders possess a unique set of...), predicting trait nouns like attributes, qualities, characteristics. Silent on ' a' after "is" or "offers". Members include possess detectors.
result.label: Article after "possess"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' se' when it begins a longer word (seismic, seamless, seeds, sewage, sectors). It predicts continuations like 'ctors', 'am', 'cur'. It stays silent on other tokens such as 'scene'.
result.label: ' se' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into pieces (' pro', ' st', ' em', ' consult', ' cogn') right after a quantity-increase word like "greater" or "increased", predicting a suffix continuation such as -ation or -isation.
result.label: Word-start fragment after "greater/increased"

result.description: Fires on ' first' (also ' important', 'crucial', 'most') in a "The first/most important [step/thing]" ranking phrase, after "the" or "most". It stays silent on 'first' as an adverb ("by first discretizing") or sentence-initial.
result.label: "The first/most important" step phrase

result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of a multi-token term, mainly ' agricult' after "precision" (precision agriculture/farming), also ' far', ' Vector', 'Opt'. Silent on ' agricult' after sustainable/urban or sentence-initially.
result.label: precision agriculture word-piece

result.description: Fires on ' with' as an instrumental or manner preposition after a noun or verb (wipe with gentle water, executed with great precision). It stays silent when 'with' follows 'start' or 'begins'. Logits favor words like care and precision.
result.label: ' with' as manner/instrument preposition

result.description: Fires on the word piece "pect" inside "perspectives" (pers|pect|ives), and also on "pect" in "Respect". Members are mostly "pect" detectors. It predicts a continuation like "ives".
result.label: "pect" piece in perspectives

result.description: Fires on the final piece of "standpoint"/"viewpoint" and on "perspective" in "from an X standpoint/perspective" phrases. It marks the point-of-view noun and weakly fires on similar phrases like "at first glance" and "in simplest terms".
result.label: standpoint / viewpoint / perspective noun

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'rac' (extracellular, embracing), 'ak' (sneaky, awakening, Tokamak) and 'ist'/'ism' when they sit inside a longer word. Members are token detectors for 'ak' and 'rac'. It predicts a word continuation.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'rac', 'ak', 'ist'

result.description: Fires on word stems that are usually followed by a suffix, mainly ' colon' (colonization, colonies), also ' pool', ' branch' and ' bank'. It predicts suffix pieces like 'ing', 'ies', 'izers'. Mostly colon-detector members.
result.label: Word stems before suffix: colon, pool
'uro' in neuro- words
result.description: Fires on the 'uro' piece in "neuro-" compounds (neuroscience, neurological, neuroimmune), and weakly on ' neu' before 'roscience'. Members detect 'uro' after 'Ne'. Fires on that word piece, not on other uses.

Fires on the word-piece ' prior' before 'itize/itizing' and on 'look' in 'overlooked', where the next piece is a suffix (-it, -ed). Silent on ' prior' after "that" in some contexts, so a construction effect may exist.
result.label: prior(itize) and overlook word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on digits inside long runs of repeated digits (0s, 9s) in numeric strings, plus scattered mid-word pieces and nouns. Silent on a '0' in an ordinary number like "100 years". Evidence is mixed and the consistency is low.
result.label: Digits in long digit runs

result.description: Fires on the word " philosophy" itself, as a noun in phrases like "analytical philosophy", "philosophy of science" or "in philosophy". Members mostly detect philosophy-related word pieces such as Philosoph, philosoph and the "y" of Philosophy.
result.label: ' philosophy' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' the' or ' of' right after words like epitomize, epitome, zenith, quintessence, pinnacle, i.e. a slot where something is described as the embodiment or peak of a quality. Predicts words like excellence, elegance, triumph.
result.label: Epitome/pinnacle 'of' slot
Hull piece in engineering headings
result.description: Fires mainly on the 'ull' piece in "Hull" at the start of engineering/naval section headings (Hull Materials, Hull Coatings). Weaker on word-final pieces like 'craft', 'ical', 'ement' in technical text. It predicts construction and engineering words.

Fires on a predicate adjective after a copula ("are common(place)", "were prevalent", "are preferred", "is necessary"), where the next words are likely a complement or reason. It stays silent on attributive "common" as in "our common humanity".
result.label: Predicate adjective after "are/were"

result.description: Fires on the token ' demand' (economic or on-demand sense) in supply-chain, forecasting and economics text. Members are mostly earlier-layer ' demand' detectors. It predicts continuations like forecasting, prediction and -ing.
result.label: ' demand' token detector

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (output, hardware, user, air, electrical) inside technical/engineering and computing descriptions, often a modifier or noun in a technical noun phrase. Peaks are scattered; logits point to institutional or engineering nouns. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Technical systems-engineering noun phrases

result.description: Fires on ' as' directly after "act/acts/serve/function" meaning "act as a X" (role sense). Silent on 'as well as', 'also as', and comparative 'as'. Predicts role nouns like agent, catalyst.
result.label: 'as' after act/serve (role as)

result.description: Fires on mixed mid-word pieces (lo in Apollo, ull in hull, wide) and on ' and' joining coordinated items, often after "peace". Peaks are scattered and low-consistency; no clear shared condition.
result.label: Scattered word pieces and 'and'

result.description: Fires on the suffix completing "anatom" (-ical, -y) in anatomy text. It stays silent on 'ical' in other words like Classical, Alchemical, empirical. Members mostly detect anatomy-style word pieces.
result.label: Anatom-ical / anatom-y suffix

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ov' (Markov, Chekhov-type surnames, photovoltaic, cardiovascular), 'ac' in vernacular, and 'roph'. Members are mostly 'ov' detectors. Predicts word continuations like -sky, -irus, -itis, -ial.
result.label: Mid-word 'ov' / 'ac' fragments

result.description: Fires on function words (the, and, of, a) and some nouns mid-phrase, especially after "and" in a definition or pair of terms (signifier/signified), where a noun or quoted term comes next. Peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Function word before defined term

result.description: Fires on varied words (e.g. "for", "diverse", "music") in text about materials' diverse characteristics and applications, such as "crucial for their various applications". It stays quiet on "crucial for" in computing/optimization text.
result.label: Diverse properties and applications phrasing

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'iv' inside split words like construct-iv-ism, object-iv-ism, posit-iv-ism, carn-iv-ores, and weakly on 'char' in polysaccharides. Silent on 'iv' in 'pivotal'. Predicts suffixes like -ism, -ist, -ities.
result.label: 'iv' piece before -ism/-ist suffix

result.description: Fires on plural person-role nouns (participants, citizens, individuals, -ers/-als) after an adjective in civic or educational text about people becoming active or responsible. Silent on verb-ending 'ers' like fosters or empowers. Predicts -hip/-ships or "who".
result.label: Plural person nouns (citizens, participants)

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, mostly ' conver' (convergent), also ' ach' (achieving), ' prof' (proficiency/profound). It predicts the continuation of the word (-gent, -ieving, -ound).
result.label: Word-start fragments: conver, ach, prof

result.description: Fires on quantifier words like "various", "many", "numerous", "several" after a preposition (e.g. "in various fields", "in many applications"), especially in expository text. It predicts a plural noun for fields or applications.
result.label: Quantifier 'various/many' after preposition

result.description: Fires on the plural biochemical suffix pieces 'ides'/'ids' ending a chemical class noun (lipids, triglycerides, polysaccharides, nucleosides). Silent on 'ides' inside other words like 'molecides' or 'widespread'.
result.label: Biochemical class suffix -ides/-ids

result.description: Fires mainly on " religion"/" Religion", with weaker, odd peaks on "ull" in "Hull" and "cies" in "intricacies". Members are mostly detectors of religion words (religious, faith, Relig). The target's peak set is mixed.
result.label: religion word, plus stray 'ull'

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " reconst" (also "const", "itation") in the middle of a word like "reconstruction", predicting the continuation "ruction". It appears mostly in academic text on linguistics and reconstruction methods.
result.label: reconst- word-piece before -ruction

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Riemann' (as in Riemann Hypothesis) and on ' bott' at the start of 'bottlenecks'. Two distinct tokens share the latent; it is mostly a Riemann detector, supported by members for math-name pieces.
result.label: Riemann and bott(lenecks) token

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces, often participle or suffix endings (' trained', 'iled', 'atile', 'es', ' typing') in the middle of a phrase. Peaks are scattered and weakly consistent; the next-token logits are weak and mixed.
result.label: Scattered participle and suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ib' mainly inside 'antibody/antibodies', also in Caribbean and Fibonacci. Members are mostly 'ib' detectors. Weak firing on 'ional' in some words.
result.label: 'ib' piece in antibody

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' marg' (as in "marginal" utility/cost/analysis), predicting the continuation "inal". Members are detectors of ' marg' and similar word-start fragments. Silent in generic economics text lacking the piece.
result.label: ' marg' word-start piece (marginal)

result.description: Fires on commas (also 'and') after an item in a list of fields, sectors or industries (healthcare, finance, ...), expecting another domain next. Silent on commas before relative clauses like 'which'.
result.label: Comma in lists of fields/sectors

result.description: Fires on the word "backup" (and "backups", "ups") in data-backup text, such as types of backup like full, incremental or differential. Members are mostly "backup" token detectors. Weak firing on a few unrelated word pieces.
result.label: backup token in data backup text

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " tour" (before -ism/-ist) in text about tourism, geography and sustainability. It also fires on " coordinate" in a few cases. Predicts the word's continuation as a noun such as stations or routes.
result.label: ' tour' as start of tourism

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ian' ending doctrine or school-of-thought adjectives such as egalitarian, utilitarian, Lagrangian, Bayesian, and predicts 'ism' next. Weakly fires on 'relativ' in moral relativism.
result.label: -ian suffix in -ism doctrine words

result.description: Fires on "ized" after "standard" (standardized) and on "of" in "unit of" (measurement), in measurement and standards contexts. It predicts "measurement" or "tests". It is silent on "ized" in "characterized".
result.label: standardized / unit of measurement

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "immerse/immersive/immersion/immersing" (ive, ersion, se, ing) after the "imm"/"immers" start. It stays silent on -ive in other words like inventive, perceive, expressive.
result.label: immers- word completion

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ative'/'ive' in adjectives like indicative, reflective, symptomatic, where the word is followed by "of". It stays silent on noun or other uses such as narrative, provocative, transformative.
result.label: indicative/reflective adjective suffix before "of"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "cel" inside "porcelain", mid-word before "ain". Weak activation on other mid-word fragments like " supre" (supremacy) and " commun" (communism).
result.label: "cel" in porcelain

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mil' when it begins "milestone" after a preceding word (e.g. "significant mil", "other mil"). It also weakly fires on "through" in "breakthrough". It stays silent when "milestones" starts the text.
result.label: "mil" in milestone

result.description: Fires on the '%' sign after a number and on the word piece 'ty' (as in "certainty", "strongly-typed"). Two unrelated tokens share the peak; the circuit has separate detectors for each.
result.label: '%' after numbers and 'ty' piece

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces (day, athlet-ic, omed, diverse, big) in materials/industry-product phrases like "from everyday items to...", "a diverse range of products". Predicts product/household-type nouns. Evidence is mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Everyday-products phrase word pieces

result.description: Fires on word pieces in thermodynamics-related words, mainly 'iger' in refrigerator/refrigeration, also 'not' in Carnot and weaker on therm-/co-oper-. Appears to need being inside these specific words in a thermal/Carnot cycle context.
result.label: refrigerator 'iger' / Carnot piece

result.description: Fires on a word-start fragment (mostly ' emb', also ' el', ' met', ' un') right after "By" at the very start of a document, as in "By embracing". It is silent on ' emb' in mid-sentence contexts. Logits favour suffix pieces like 'ester', 'iled'.
result.label: Document-initial "By" + word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' diss' (dissipation, dissent, dissatisfaction) and sometimes other mid-word pieces like 'ic' in genomic. Needs an incomplete word whose continuation is a multi-piece word. Upstream members are fragment detectors (rev, disp, inher, Hyp, ha).
result.label: ' diss' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece (-ing, -es, -ed) completing the verb "enrich", e.g. "enrich[ing] the reader". It stays silent on -ing after other verbs like unlocking or encouraging. Predicts objects such as lives, experiences, our.
result.label: suffix after "enrich"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "mer", mostly in "simmer", "simmering" and "simmered" in cooking text. It also fires weakly in "warmer" and "Merger". Next-token logits favor continuations like "ged" and "gar".
result.label: "mer" piece in simmer

result.description: Fires on " necessary" as a modifier after "the" following "provide(s)" (e.g. "provides the necessary infrastructure"). Stays silent on predicative "may not be necessary". Members detect necessary/needed/required/correct.
result.label: "the necessary" after provide

result.description: Fires on a period ending a sentence, especially in advice or instructional prose about writing or safety. It stays quiet on periods inside URLs or abbreviations like "e.g." and on some other sentence ends.
result.label: Sentence-final period in expository text

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and nouns (' nor', ' and', '/', ' of', ' across', ' economy') in technical or grammatical/logical explanatory text, often in coordinated lists or conjunction discussions. Peaks are mixed; evidence is weak and the circuit failed.
result.label: Conjunctions in grammar/logic lists

result.description: Fires on ' to' or ' by' that complete causal-attribution phrases like "thanks to", "due to", "owing to", "fueled by", "spurred by", introducing a cause. Stays silent on "led to", "designed to", and infinitive 'to'.
result.label: Causal 'thanks to' / 'fueled by'

result.description: Fires on the last piece of a plural noun (landscapes, societies, paradigms, shifts, changes) that ends a phrase about shifting societal or cultural change, as in "reflecting changing cultural landscapes". Silent in a looser, non-descriptive context.
result.label: Societal/cultural change plural nouns

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: mid-word pieces in "hemicellulose", and ' of'/' to' after nouns like "cost of", in science and business text. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low. The circuit failed and the evidence is thin.
result.label: Mixed scattered tokens, hemicellulose pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ph' when it begins a word like phonotactics, phonetic or phonological, mostly in linguistics text about phonology. It stays quiet on ' ph' after "and" or at document start, and fires more weakly on pharmaceutical contexts.
result.label: ' ph' piece in phonology words

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'oid' inside words like Solenoid, Toroid, steroid, ellipsoid, geoid. It is a word-final suffix token that follows a stem piece, and members mostly detect 'oid' itself.
result.label: 'oid' suffix in -oid words

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces in language/linguistics text, mainly ' ling' (as in lingua franca), also ' phr' (phrases), ' ev', ' ha'. Predicts a word continuation fragment such as 'ua' or 'ases'.
result.label: Linguistics word-start fragments (ling, phr)

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' h' (a space-prefixed 'h' that starts a word split into pieces), mostly before 'ormone', 'ug', 'iring' or 'ygiene'. It predicts continuations like 'yg', 'orm', 'ind'. It was silent on one 'hormone' context.
result.label: Word-initial ' h' fragment

result.description: Fires on food and culinary words (' Food', ' Menu', 'inary', dish pieces), especially as a title or heading word at document start, with cooking and restaurant members supporting it. Silent on other list-style topic headings.
result.label: Food/menu culinary heading words

result.description: Fires on the final suffix piece of biology process nouns, mostly "resp-iration" and "photosyn-thesis", also "-ction", "-acy", "-ility" in life-science text. It completes a word naming a biological process.
result.label: Biological process word endings (respiration)

result.description: Fires on emphasis adverbs like " particularly", " especially", and sometimes " dominant" or "-ably", mostly after a comma or "is" in academic text, where a focusing qualifier introduces a specific subset. Silent on attributive "a particularly fruitful".
result.label: Focusing adverb 'particularly/especially'

result.description: Fires on the backslash that starts a LaTeX command inside math (e.g. \sin\alpha, \( \frac), mostly ' \' and '\'. Weaker, scattered firing on pieces of Cyrillic words and word fragments. Silent on plain-text logic notation.
result.label: LaTeX backslash in math

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: digits inside slash- or digit-separated number strings (e.g. '1' in 3/4/4/1), plus odd word pieces like 'ware', 'swift', 'my'. Peaks are inconsistent; the numeric-string case is the clearest. Silent on a '1' in a numbered heading.
result.label: Digits in number strings, mixed

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Fin" (as in Financial, Finance, FinTech) at the start of a heading or title, where a continuation like "-ancial" is expected. Weaker on other incomplete word-initial pieces (Bi-oge, D-iffer, Cir).
result.label: Fin- word-start piece (Financial)

result.description: Fires on the word " printing" in historical or technical text about the printing press and industry (e.g. "the printing press", "printing industry"). It is silent in the one contrast example, where " printing" starts the text.
result.label: ' printing' in press/industry context

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' inter' when it is a prefix mid-word, mostly before "ference" (interference), also "play" and "personal". Silent on it at the start of a text. Predicts continuations like ference, play, connected.
result.label: ' inter' prefix mid-text

result.description: Fires on prepositions or words (on, in, to, the, with, of) right after verbs or nouns like "hinges", "lies", "tied", "requires understanding", in abstract expository prose. It is silent on "on" after data or depending. It predicts abstract nouns such as factors or strategies.
result.label: Dependency-verb prepositions in expository prose

result.description: Fires mostly on ' mit' in "to mit|igate" (verb-infinitive slot expecting a word continuation), with weaker hits on other word pieces (-ly, -ivity, 'be'). Silent on ' mit' in "mitigation" after a noun context.
result.label: ' mit' of "to mitigate"

result.description: Fires on the pronoun "it" (any case) as a clause subject, often after a conjunction or sentence start such as "because it", "When it comes", "While it". Members are mostly "it" detectors. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: Subject pronoun "it"

result.description: Fires on abstract process nouns (selection, implementation, promotion, -ance) appearing as items in a comma- or semicolon-separated list of activities. Weakly predicts " of" next. Silent on ordinary prose.
result.label: Process nouns in activity lists

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'ip' in "dissipation" (also ' toler' in "tolerance"), where the word continues with a suffix like -ation/-ance. Mostly in physics and science text, and it predicts the suffix.
result.label: 'ip' in dissipation, word-piece

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments and hyphens inside multi-piece words or ranges, mainly 'nell' in Snell's, 'bit' in orbitals, and '-' in ranges like 18th-20th. Evidence is mixed, with a weak logit signal.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: nell, bit, hyphen

result.description: Fires on ' integrated' (also 'unified', 'comprehensive', 'detailed') as an attributive adjective after "an"/"a" before a noun, like "an integrated approach". Silent on predicative "can be integrated with".
result.label: attributive 'integrated' adjective after article

result.description: Fires on the last word of an international treaty or agreement name (Convention, treaty, Protocol, agreement) in diplomatic/UN contexts, predicting words like Convention, Conference, signed, nations.
result.label: International treaty/convention names

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' eth' at the start of words like ethics, ethical, ethnic, ethers, ethyl. It predicts continuations such as 'nic', 'yl', 'ical'. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' eth' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ch" when it begins "chord" (music chords, circle chords), often after words like seventh, longest, least. Predicts continuations such as "ord", "ords". Mostly silent elsewhere.
result.label: " ch" starting "chord"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'asing' in "purchasing", mostly in "purchasing power", and predicts ' power'. Members detect buy/purchase/-asing/-ying tokens in commerce contexts.
result.label: 'asing' in purchasing

result.description: Fires on verbs of position or location (sit, sitting, lying, located, nestled, lies) that describe where something is. Predicts a following location word like ahead, nearby, beside, below. Members detect located/situated/lie/live.
result.label: Positional verbs: sit, lie, located

result.description: Fires on the token ' knowledge' (and the 'ledge' piece of 'Knowledge') in all contexts, including knowledge representation and epistemology text. Members are mostly detectors of the same word. It predicts continuations like base, about, management, sharing.
result.label: ' knowledge' token detector

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in a modifier slot after "The"/"the" or inside a century or number, such as "18th", "200", " long", " scientific", " early", before a noun. It is silent on many "1" tokens in years. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Pre-noun modifier and number tokens

result.description: Fires on the word " half", mostly in "half-life" and "half the" in physics text. Its members are mostly detectors of " half". It predicts compound or measure words next, such as "-life", "way" and "percent".
result.label: ' half' token, as in half-life

result.description: Fires on "energy"/"Energy" when it completes a technical compound term, especially "Gibbs free energy" and other physical-chemistry phrases. It stays silent on sentence-initial "Energy" as a bare topic word. Minor weak firing on other word pieces.
result.label: Energy after "Gibbs free" terms

result.description: Fires mainly on the word "jazz" (also "Jazz") as a music genre in descriptions of music styles and festivals. Also fires on a secondary piece 'kes'. Silent on "jazz age", a non-music use.
result.label: jazz music genre word

result.description: Fires on verbs of investigation (study, explore, examine, analyzing, delves into) when a course or document summary describes what a section or work covers, e.g. "This study examines various...". Silent on plain value statements.
result.label: Study/explore/examine verbs in summaries

result.description: Fires on the 'oz' piece inside geological era names like Cenozoic, Paleozoic and Mesozoic (the "-zoic" split). It needs that word-internal position, with the preceding Cen-/Pale-/Mes- piece.
result.label: 'oz' in Cenozoic/Paleozoic/Mesozoic

result.description: Fires on the token ' mirror' (noun or verb, including in compounds like 'shop mirrors' and 'mirror surfaces'). Upstream members detect 'mirror' and 'reflect' tokens. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' mirror' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' this' as a demonstrative determiner after a verb or preposition, in technical or explanatory text, where an abstract noun like process, type or effect comes next. Silent on sentence-initial ' this'.
result.label: ' this' before abstract noun

result.description: Fires on the token 'h' when it is a mid-word piece after a prefix, as in "de|hydrogenase" or "Aest|hetic", where the word continues. It stays silent on 'h' at the start of a name.
result.label: 'h' inside split words (de-h-ydro)

result.description: Fires on " the" right after a sentence-opening temporal preposition (During, At, By, Towards) at the start of a document, in phrases like "At the end of" or "During the period". Silent on " the" after verbs like "marked" or "into".
result.label: "the" after opening temporal preposition

result.description: Fires on the second word or word-piece of a "Language X" topic heading in a list of linguistics subfields (Pl-anning, Document-ation, Ass-essment, Education). Silent on similar tokens after other topics like "Power System" or "Incident Response".
result.label: Language-topic heading continuation

result.description: Fires mainly on the mid-word piece 'char' in saccharides (mono-/di-/polysaccharides), plus a few other word-internal fragments (ym, ary, mot, blank-et). Seems to predict a word-completing suffix. Mixed, weak evidence.
result.label: 'char' in saccharide words
' the' after "founded on / born from"
result.description: Fires on ' the' following verbs or prepositions of origin or basis ("founded on the", "born from the", "builds upon the"). It predicts abstract nouns like idea, principles, notion. It stays quiet on ' the' after other verbs and prepositions.

Fires on the word " forces" (plural of force), mostly as a physics or mechanics noun like "forces and stresses" or "nuclear forces". Members are mainly detectors of "force/forces". Predicts continuations like "acting".
result.label: ' forces' token detector

result.description: Fires on " from" right after "transition" or similar change/shift/move words (transition from X to Y). Silent on " from" after "resulting", "lasted", "varied", or "appearance", where it isn't a change-of-state source.
result.label: "from" after transition/shift

result.description: Fires on the word right after "play(ed) a significant/important role in" (the, both, scientific, in), where the next word names the domain or area. Silent on "in the" in other constructions.
result.label: Slot after "role in"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' val' (as in valve, valence, valued) when it is a split-off beginning of a longer word, with the model expecting a continuation like -ves or -ence. Strongest in heart valve text.
result.label: ' val' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after "combination" (also union/intersection-like nouns), where the next word is the items being combined. Silent on ' of' after quantity or other nouns like "amounts of" or "safety of".
result.label: 'of' after combination

result.description: Fires on the word "speech" (and "disc-ourse") as a noun in linguistic or communication-studies text, such as speech acts, direct speech, and discourse analysis. Predicts compound continuations like patterns, structure, analysis.
result.label: speech / discourse noun

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-start piece ' Ar' (as in Arbitrage, Arctic, Arithmetic) when it begins a word that continues in the next token. Members detect ' Ar' and similar word-start fragments (Tri, Tre, IP, Old).
result.label: Word-initial ' Ar' fragment

result.description: Fires on the 'ythm' piece in "rhythm" (after "rh"), in music and heart-rhythm contexts. It is silent when 'ythm' starts a document without the preceding "rh". Predicts suffixes like -ical, -ic, -mic.
result.label: rh-ythm word piece

result.description: Fires on the standalone token 'c' as a word piece or subscript (cres-c-endo, V_c, P_c, mole-c-ule, trans-c-end). It is silent on 'c' in some other words, such as recon-c-iliation, so the surrounding word matters.
result.label: 'c' piece inside words/subscripts

result.description: Fires on bare verbs (discuss, support, share, edit) inside comma-separated lists of activity verbs, e.g. "gather, share, exhibit, discuss, communicate". Silent when "discuss" is not a list item, such as "will discuss topics" or "discussions".
result.label: Verb in list of verbs

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' of', ' and', ' point', ' within', ' central', ' networks') in technical, math and statistics text, mostly mid-phrase. The same ' of' stays silent elsewhere, and the evidence for what it needs is weak.
result.label: Scattered tokens in technical math text

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-start piece " combin" (combinatorics/combinatorial), where the next piece is predicted to complete the word. It also fires weakly on other incomplete word starts such as " simpl" and " handling". Members detect combinatorics word pieces.
result.label: combin- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the piece 'le' in "inter-le-aving" (memory interleaving), after the prefix "inter". It stays silent on 'le' in other words such as Role, jungle, subtle and bottleneck. Members detect "inter" + piece and 'le' endings.
result.label: 'le' in interleaving

result.description: Fires on 'hardware' and 'drivers'/'driver' in computing text about operating systems, devices and components, often as a modifier before a noun like components or conflicts. Predicts hardware-related continuations (bus, peri...).
result.label: Hardware / drivers in computing text
' typ' word-start piece (typography/typology)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' typ' when it begins a longer word such as typography, typographic or typology. Members are mostly ' typ' detectors, plus a few other word-start fragments. It predicts suffixes like 'ography' and 'ology'.

Fires on the word-piece ' dis' as a standalone token, mostly when the next piece is likely "order(s)" (e.g. "genetic dis|orders"), and more weakly before "charge" or "sonance". Predicts "order/orders/ordered".
result.label: ' dis' prefix before 'order'

result.description: Fires on a linking verb (mostly ' is', also ' are', ' can', "'s") right after an abstract or generic plural/mass subject noun in expository essay text (e.g. "transparency is", "character names are"). Silent after pronouns, "It", or in other slots.
result.label: Copula after abstract subject noun

result.description: Fires on the first word piece of a rare or multi-piece word (u|rethra, ins|idious, con|noisseur, cor|nea) right after "the" at the start of a noun phrase. Silent on similar pieces after other words such as "to", "of" or "a".
result.label: Word-start piece after "the"

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-initial fragments such as ' prof', ' emp', ' pe', ' Fin' that begin a longer word (profound, proficient, empower, employs, peeling). It predicts the continuation pieces (ound, ower, oss).
result.label: Word-start fragments prof/emp/pe

result.description: Fires on the word "angular" / "Angular", mostly in physics text about angular momentum, velocity and displacement. Members are mostly detectors of "angular" and related physics words (scalar, thermal, gamma). The contrast text lacks the word itself.
result.label: "angular" in physics text

result.description: Fires on the single letter 'n' used as a math variable (index, subscript, factorial or combinatorial argument) in mathematical text. Silent on 'n' inside quotes at the start of a document, where it is not a math variable.
result.label: Variable 'n' in math expressions

result.description: Fires on the token ' framework' (and more weakly ' frameworks'), mostly in lists or overviews of software and conceptual frameworks. Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' framework' token detector

result.description: Fires on a mix of function words (' if', ' an', ' a') and ' remark', mostly where the word starts a conditional or modifier phrase. It stays silent on ' if' after verbs like "check if" or "know if". Members are noisy and non-discriminative; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Conditional 'if' / 'an' mixed function words
